title: Questions, information and answers required before any decision can reasonably be made
policy: Answers that are not established from evidence are left BLANK (published as 'blank — not established'). Nothing is inferred. Each unknown carries a discovery action so the missing information can be obtained.

rows.question: Where will official market open/close prices come from?
rows.blocks: R4 market/difference columns, G7, any real staking ROI, reward payments
rows.known: The NFL publishes no betting lines; every market cell in this project is blank (FB-01). Our own open/close snapshots exist in the price-snapshot store.
rows.discovery: Decision needed: license a historical odds archive (e.g., a regulated data provider) or accept permanent blank market columns. See suggestion SG-01.

rows.question: What price is actually obtainable for a straight-up side pick?
rows.known: Staking here assumes flat -110 on any pick (declared in strategies.json). Real prices for favorites are much heavier juice.
rows.discovery: Requires Q01's price source; then recompute staking at observed prices. Until then staking numbers are mechanical, not achievable (FB-02).

rows.question: Are the 105 games of weeks 2-8 correct?
rows.known: All 32 teams' aggregates match the official standings read this session (160/160 cells); 32 games re-read line-by-line match; 105 rows are aggregate-verified only.
rows.discovery: Re-read the 105 remaining official game pages one by one (suggestion SG-02).

rows.question: What is the model's fair line versus the market line?
rows.known: Fair lines are published for all 13 Week 11 games; market lines are blank.
rows.discovery: Q01. Difference column populates automatically once market lines exist.

rows.question: Which strategies are genuinely skill-based rather than lucky?
rows.known: S1 beat the pre-registered coin-flip baseline (0.673, CI 0.578-0.756, placebo p<0.002) and edges the contemporaneous better-record baseline (0.635) but the gap is not pre-registered as a test; S2/S3 fail their skill/staking gates; S4 n=7.
rows.discovery: Prospective Week 11+ evaluation (G8) with the pre-registered rules unchanged; a pre-registered paired test vs the record baseline (SG-05).

rows.question: What depth (2nd/3rd/4th string) do replacements sit at?
rows.blocks: R6 depth tracking completeness, deficiency adjustments
rows.known: SEA QB proven: Lock = 'the backup' (1st), Milroe = rookie backup (2nd) — official article. MIA McCord's string not stated (blank). No official depth chart exists (nfl.com/depth-charts/ 404s).
rows.discovery: Transcribe official game-book substitution charts weekly (they carry codes like 3QB) — suggestion SG-06; or accept blank depth.

rows.question: How much do official injuries move the line?
rows.known: Official Week 10 report captured for 10 of 32 teams this session; no archived historical reports exist.
rows.discovery: Start a dated weekly injury-report archive now (SG-07); without history no effect size can ever be estimated.

rows.question: Should rewards be paid at all before prices are verified?
rows.known: Amendment A1 holds all points at 0 until G7 passes; no funds are held.
rows.discovery: Owner decision on SG-02/SG-03 timing; policy already blocks payout.

rows.question: Is the assumed -110 parlay price correct for cross-game parlays?
rows.known: S4 uses the declared product price (10/11)^2; n=7 settled so far.
rows.discovery: Q01 price source; then reprice S4 legs at observed prices.

rows.question: Which single NFL dashboard is canonical (17 namespaces now exist)?
rows.known: Root navigation lists every namespace; each has its own verifier; consolidation has been suggested by multiple sessions.
rows.discovery: Owner picks one namespace to keep as canonical (SG-08); others become archives.

rows.question: Is home-field advantage real in 2026 (fitted HFA = 0.15 pts)?
rows.known: Fitted HFA on 137 official games is +0.15 points (model_card.json), far below the historical ~2-3; sample includes neutral-site games flagged.
rows.discovery: Extend training with prior-season official results (official nfl.com season pages) or wait for more 2026 games (SG-09).

rows.question: Do player props exist anywhere with official prices?
rows.known: No official prop prices in any source read; official player logs DO exist (nfl.com player stat pages).
rows.discovery: Q01; without prices props stay blocked forever (FB-05).

rows.question: What is the legal position on publishing originated lines and rewards?
rows.known: Project publishes research points only; no funds; no wagering is offered.
rows.discovery: Owner obtains jurisdiction-specific advice before any monetization (SG-10).

rows.question: Are Week 11 kickoff times still as scheduled?
rows.known: Schedule read from nfl.com on 2026-11-14 (13 games).
rows.discovery: Re-read the Week 11 schedule page immediately before kickoffs; refresh the close snapshot (SG-11).

rows.question: Does the model beat a naive record-based picker out of sample?
rows.known: Post-hoc on weeks 3-10: model 0.673 vs contemporaneous better-record 0.635 (n=104); the difference is +3.8pp and was NOT pre-registered as a test.
rows.discovery: Pre-register the paired comparison now and run it on Week 11+ data only (SG-05).
